meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: US sales tax compliance software for mid-market ecommerce and SaaS brands

analysis.summary: Rivals are scaling up fast. Zamp, Numeral and Kintsugi now publish far more than TaxCloud, and Zamp and Kintsugi chase the same switchers with comparison pages.

points.text: Zamp (119 comparison pages) and Kintsugi (22, with an Avalara alternatives page) now fight TaxCloud's 24 comparison pages for switchers.
Numeral went from 6 to 268 pages in 30 days. It has 161 how-tos and 23 short case studies of ecommerce brands.
Avalara and TaxJar mostly write for learners: 30 of 84 pages and 58 of 77. They leave switchers to others.

shared.title: State-by-state guides
shared.text: Avalara (nexus), TaxJar (shipping), Numeral (filing) and Kintsugi (SaaS, filing) publish page after page by state. It's a search net for learners. TaxCloud's 105 state pages compete here.

shared.title: Rival comparison pages
shared.text: Zamp prices out Avalara and TaxJar. Kintsugi lists alternatives to Avalara, Anrok, Numeral, Vertex and Zamp. Numeral has 27 comparison pages. Buyers weighing a switch see many rivals' pitches.

shared.title: Customer stories at scale
shared.text: Numeral (23) and Zamp (20) publish many short brand stories, mostly ecommerce. TaxCloud has 17 with stronger numbers, such as 70% less time. Proof is now standard.

gaps.title: Switching from other rivals
gaps.text: TaxCloud has an AvaTax migration guide. In these pages, no one covers leaving TaxJar, Zamp, Numeral or Anrok. Only Anrok has one general switching page.

gaps.title: Webinars and live events
gaps.text: Avalara runs many webinar pages, from Shopify sellers to the Streamlined program (SST). No other rival, TaxCloud included, does. Mid-market teams may want live Q&A before switching.

gaps.title: Mid-market proof
gaps.text: No company's titles name mid-market brands. Anrok targets startups and enterprise, and Numeral and Zamp show small brands. Stories with revenue size, and audit and multi-state migration detail, are open.
